slides.title: Fill to the mark
slides.text: The top room of the Mixing Tower holds tall glass tanks. Each label gives a percent, not an amount: fill to 30%. Tally shrugs. A percent is only a rate, and you have just met rates.

slides.title: Percent means per 100
slides.text: Percent means for each 100. In a tank that holds 100 milliliters, 30% is 30 milliliters. A percent is a rate per 100, so it scales like any other ratio: in a tank of 200 milliliters, 30% is 60.

visual.label: A percent bar for a tank of 100 milliliters: 30% filled with oil and 70% empty

focus.cue: 30% of the tank: 30 of its 100 milliliters.

slides.title: 30% of 250 milliliters
slides.text: Fill a 250 milliliter tank to 30%. Find 10% first by dividing by 10, then take three of those parts. The answer is 75 milliliters, not 30: the 30 is a rate, not an amount.
steps: check: 75 is less than half of 250

visual.label: A percent bar for a tank of 250 milliliters cut into ten parts of 25 milliliters, with three parts filled

rows.label: Ten equal parts: each is 10%, or 25 ml

focus.cue: One part is 10% of the tank: 25 milliliters.

slides.title: From a part to the whole
slides.text: Sometimes you know the part and its percent, and need the whole. If 20 milliliters is 25% of a tank, then 20 is one of four equal parts. Four parts of 20 make a full tank of 80 milliliters.

visual.label: A tank as four equal parts of 25% each: one part is 20 milliliters, so four parts are 80 milliliters

focus.cue: The part you know: 20 milliliters is 25%.

slides.title: Changing units is a rate too
slides.text: Units change at a fixed rate: 1 kilometer is 1000 meters. A path of 3 kilometers is 3 × 1000 = 3000 meters. If each lantern lights 250 meters, the path needs 3000 ÷ 250 = 12 lanterns. Change the units first, then divide.

visual.label: A double number line of kilometers and meters: 1 kilometer is 1000 meters, 2 is 2000 and 3 is 3000

focus.cue: The rate: every 1 kilometer is 1000 meters.

slides.title: Words to know
slides.text: Four words for percents and units.

words.means: a rate for each 100, written with the sign %
some of the whole, such as the 75 milliliters in a tank of 250
to write the same measure in a different unit, such as kilometers as meters

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Lantern Mix at Fill and Convert. Fill each tank to its percent, find the full tank, and change units to light the path. Six lanterns finish the step.
slides.alt: Lantern Mix on a phone: an empty tank of 80 milliliters to fill to 50% on the board, and a dial to set.
